props.name: as
props.description: The element or component this component should render as. Can be overwritten by `asChild`.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render through the passed child element instead of the default one, merging
their props and behavior while keeping the primitive's.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The pressed state of the toggle when it is initially rendered. Use when you do not need to control its open state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When `true`, prevents the user from interacting with the toggle.

props.name: icon
props.description: Iconify name rendered inside the toggle when no default slot is supplied.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The controlled pressed state of the toggle. Can be bind as `v-model`.

slots.name: default
slots.type: { modelValue: boolean; state: "off" | "on"; pressed: boolean; disabled: boolean; iconColor: string; }
slots.description: Pressed state and disabled flag forwarded from the core primitive.
